info.name: ecommerce-backend
info.description:
Every endpoint of the ecommerce-backend API.

Kept in sync with the code by PostmanCollectionSyncIT: the build fails if an API endpoint exists that is not in this collection.

Quick flow: Register -> Mailpit: get token from latest email -> Verify email -> Login -> any protected request.

The access token is saved automatically after Login, Refresh and Change password. The refresh token is an HttpOnly cookie that Postman's cookie jar stores and sends by itself.

request.description: Public connectivity check. Returns the standard success envelope.
Infrastructure health including the database.
Always 202, whether or not the email exists. Then run 'Mailpit: get token from latest email'.
Consumes the one-time token from the verification email.
Always 202. Earlier links stop working.
Saves the access token to {{accessToken}}. The refresh_token cookie goes into Postman's cookie jar.
Uses the refresh_token cookie (sent automatically). Rotates it and saves the new access token.
Revokes the refresh token in the cookie and deletes the cookie. Always 204.
Bearer token required. Revokes every refresh token of the user.
Bearer token required. Ends other sessions, returns a new one. On success the {{password}} and {{newPassword}} variables are swapped, so you can run it again.
Always 202. Then run 'Mailpit: get token from latest email' to fill {{resetToken}}.
Sets the new password and ends every session. On success the password variables are swapped.
Bearer token required. The signed-in account.
Everything the platform holds about you: account, roles, devices, organisations, profile, addresses. A download (Content-Disposition: attachment), never cached. 5 per 15 minutes per IP.
Bearer token required. Irreversible without an administrator (Phase 3). Use a throwaway email.
Signed-in devices, newest activity first; 'current' marks this one. Saves the first non-current session as {{sessionId}}.
Signs out that device: it can no longer refresh. 404 for unknown sessions or sessions of other users.
Bearer token required. Anonymises the account for good: email, password, sessions, email links and roles are removed. The email can be registered again. Use a throwaway account.

item.name: Profile
item.description: The signed-in person's own profile and address book. No account ID in any URL: the account comes from the token, and another person's address ID answers 404. Erasure deletes both.

request.description: Empty and without a version until the first save. Saves {{profileVersion}} (null before the first save).
Replaces every field; one left out is cleared. Run Get profile first: the version must match (null for the first save), otherwise 409 CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION. Saves the new {{profileVersion}}.
Newest first, at most 20, no paging.

201 with Location. The first address is the default for both. Country rules: postal code format where known, region in US, CA, AU, IN. 409 PROFILE_ADDRESS_LIMIT after 20. Saves {{addressId}} and {{addressVersion}}.
404 for an address that is not yours. Saves {{addressVersion}}.
Replaces everything, default flags included (left out means unset). Send the version you read; 409 CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION otherwise.
204. A deleted default leaves no default of that kind.

item.name: Organisations
item.description: Seller organisations as their members see them. Any signed-in account can create one and becomes its owner; it starts PENDING_APPROVAL. Non-members get 404.

request.description: Slug: 3 to 50 lower-case letters, digits and hyphens; immutable. 409 ORG_SLUG_TAKEN or ORG_LIMIT_REACHED (3 owned). Saves {{orgId}} and {{orgVersion}}.
Newest first, with your role in each.
Includes myRole and myPermissions. Saves {{orgVersion}}.
Owner or manager. Send the version you read; 409 CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION otherwise. 409 ORG_INVALID_STATUS when suspended or closed.
Owners only. Data and slug are kept; open invitations are revoked. 409 ORG_INVALID_STATUS when suspended.

item.name: Organisations: members
item.description: Invitations need the invitee's consent: they accept the emailed link while signed in with the invited address. Get the token from Mailpit (Dev tools) into {{invitationToken}}.

request.description: MEMBER_MANAGE; the role must be below yours (owners may invite owners). Inviting the same address again replaces the link. Saves {{invitationId}}.
MEMBER_MANAGE. Open, unexpired invitations, newest first.
Idempotent. The link stops working.
Sign in as the invited address first. 400 ORG_INVALID_INVITATION for unknown, used, revoked, expired or someone else's link.
Any member. Longest-serving first. Saves the newest member as {{memberId}}.
MEMBER_MANAGE; current and new role below yours. 409 ORG_LAST_OWNER when demoting the last owner.
MEMBER_MANAGE and a higher rank. Not yourself: use Leave.
Any member. 409 ORG_LAST_OWNER for the last owner of an open organisation.
Requires role:read (the ADMIN role). As a CUSTOMER this returns 403.
Requires role:read.
Requires role:write and every permission you include. Saves {{roleId}} and {{roleVersion}}.
Requires role:read. Refreshes {{roleVersion}}.
Requires role:write. Sends {{roleVersion}}; a stale one returns 409 CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION.
Requires role:write. Fails with 409 while the role is assigned.
Requires role:read. Set {{userId}} to the target account's id (its /me response shows it).
Requires role:assign and every permission of the role. Idempotent. Not allowed on yourself (403 RBAC_SELF_MODIFICATION_DENIED). The user sees it after their next refresh.
Requires role:assign. Idempotent. CUSTOMER cannot be revoked; the last active ADMIN cannot be demoted (409 RBAC_LAST_ADMIN).

Requires user:read. Newest first. Optional filters: status=PENDING_VERIFICATION|ACTIVE|DEACTIVATED|SUSPENDED, email=<case-insensitive prefix>. size is 1 to 100. Saves the first row's id as {{userId}}.
Requires user:read. 'me' finds me@example.com. % and _ match literally.
Requires user:read. Status history, lockout, active sessions, roles and permissions.
Needs profile:read (user:read is not enough). Profile and addresses; every view is logged with your ID. 404 for unknown and erased accounts.
Requires user:manage and every permission the account holds. Ends all its sessions. The reason is internal. 409 USER_INVALID_STATUS unless ACTIVE; 409 RBAC_LAST_ADMIN for the last admin.
Requires user:manage. For SUSPENDED or DEACTIVATED accounts.
Requires user:manage. Ends a lockout after failed logins. Idempotent.
Requires user:manage. Ends every session; access tokens already issued expire within 15 minutes. Idempotent.
Requires user:erase. For a privacy request that reached support. Works in any status; a second call is 409 USER_INVALID_STATUS.

item.name: Administration: organisations
item.description: Platform staff (org:read, org:manage). Not allowed on an organisation you are a member of (403 ORG_CONFLICT_OF_INTEREST).

request.description: Requires org:read. Saves the newest pending one as {{adminOrgId}}.
Requires org:read. Includes the internal status reason and member counts.
Requires org:manage. PENDING_APPROVAL only.
Requires org:manage. ACTIVE only. The reason is never shown to members.
Requires org:manage. SUSPENDED only.
Requires org:manage. Any status except CLOSED.

item.name: Mailpit: get token from latest email

request.description: Not part of the API. Reads the newest email sent to {{email}} from Mailpit and copies its token into {{verificationToken}} or {{resetToken}}.

exec: if (!match) { console.log('No token link in: ' + latest.Subject); return; }
